# cairn skillpack pack

Build a `.cairnpack` archive from passing skill candidates

## Help

```text
Build a `.cairnpack` archive from passing skill candidates

Usage: cairn skillpack pack [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> --version <VERSION> --cairn-compat <COMPAT> --description <DESC> --candidates <ID1,ID2,...>

Options:
      --name <NAME>               Human-readable pack name
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>      Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides
                                  CAIRN_VAULT)
      --version <VERSION>         Semver pack version (e.g. 0.1.0)
      --cairn-compat <COMPAT>     Minimum Cairn version requirement (e.g. >=0.1.0)
      --description <DESC>        Pack description
      --candidates <ID1,ID2,...>  Comma-separated list of candidate ids to include
      --output <DIR>              Directory to write the archive (default: vault root)
  -h, --help                      Print help
```
